notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.content:
Remember when Monster In The Dark Remastered came out? Then the game came out meager in terms of graphics and mechanics. But with the advent of HDRP in Unity, we decided to make it for a new engine, what can appear after the release of the update?
Addition:
- "Monster in the Dark 2"
- "Monster in the Dark: Multiplayer" (50/50)
- "Monster in the Dark: Meet Him"

Bye everyone!
